name: Serene Modern Villa
description: An exquisite villa blending modern aesthetics with serene natural elements. Features an open-concept living space, large glass walls for ample natural light, and a beautifully landscaped garden with a private pool. Ideal for those who appreciate luxury and tranquility.
planDetails:
5 Bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms
Spacious open-plan living and dining area
Modern kitchen with island
Gourmet kitchen with high-end appliances
Private home theater
Infinity pool and landscaped garden
3-car garage

basic.description: Standard quality finishes and materials, providing a comfortable and modern living space.

luxury.description: Luxury finishes with imported materials, premium appliances, and custom fittings.

architecturalDesign.description: Comprehensive architectural plans for the Serene Modern Villa.
architecturalDesign.overview: Includes detailed floor plans, elevations, cross-sections, and 3D renderings to visualize the final structure.

structuralDesign.description: Detailed structural engineering drawings and specifications.
structuralDesign.overview: Covers all structural elements including foundation, framing, and roof structure to ensure stability and safety.

billOfQuantities.overview: Provides an itemized list of all materials, parts, and labor required to construct the villa.
